remarks: Lovely and spacious raised ranch in wonderful central Wilton location. Large spacious rooms throughout. Downstairs family room with fireplace. Very nice spacious kitchen with an eat in area. Nice deck off kitchen for outdoor dining. Large oversized living room great for entertaining. First level has separate/private eat in area with private bedroom and bath. Many living options.  Level front yard great for sports and throwing a pitch.  Located down the street from the Lake Club with pool.  Very lovely spacious home. Exceptionally well maintained home. Come take a look.
